identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open, Multi-center Phase Ⅰ/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of CT032 Humanized CD19 Autologous Car T Cell Injection in Patients With Relapsed and/or Refractory Non-Hodgkin's B Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is a single-arm, open label, phase I/II clinical trial to evaluate the safety, efficacy and cellular kinetics of CT032 CAR-CD19 T cells in patients with R/R B-NHL. The study is composed of two stages, Phase I stage is for dose escalation and recommendation of phase 2 dose, and Phase II stage is to verify the efficacy and safety of the dose proposed.
